U.S. Fertility Rate (1950-2026)

## U.S. Fertility Rate (1950-2026)

##### U.S. fertility rate for 2026 is 1.79, a 0.11% increase from 2025.

- U.S. fertility rate for 2025 was 1.79, a 0.06% increase from 2024.
- U.S. fertility rate for 2024 was 1.79, a 0.11% increase from 2023.
- U.S. fertility rate for 2023 was 1.78, a 0.11% increase from 2022.

Total fertility rate represents the number of children that would be born to a woman if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years and bear children in accordance with age-specific fertility rates of the specified year. The full historical dataset is available for download here: U.S. Fertility Rate | Historical Data | 1950 - 2026.
